name: photo-date-organizer
description: Sort a messy folder of phone photos, screenshots and videos into year/month folders by the date they were taken — read from EXIF, the video's creation time or a date in the file name, with the file time only as a last resort — and optionally rename them to 20261002_091500.jpg. Every file shows where its date came from, you can correct any date, and a move can be undone. Runs locally; no API keys.

Every file shows where its date came from, you can correct any date, and a move can be undone. Runs locally; no API keys.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把乱七八糟的手机照片、截图和视频，按拍摄日期整理进“年/月”文件夹——日期取自 EXIF、视频创建时间或文件名里的日期，最后才用文件修改时间——还可以统一改名成 20261002_091500.jpg。每个文件都标明日期来源，日期可以手动改正，移动后还能撤销。在本地运行，无需 API 密钥。
